name: 33029 · Pembroke Pnes, FL
findings: ZIP 33029 (Pembroke Pnes) has 142 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33029 (Pembroke Pnes) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
